findings.reason: The fragment sets DeletionPolicy on the AWS::RDS::DBInstance, Snapshot unless infra.overrides.DeletionPolicy names another, and sets no UpdateReplacePolicy, so a replacement of the instance during a stack update keeps the default Delete and drops the database without the snapshot; cfn-lint asks for both.
